source: Phase C smoke-tested configs/baseline.json and implementation

constants.sampler: deterministic weighted replacement sampling targeting 50% defective images

phase_required_constant.reason: D1 requires the same maximum eight-epoch screening duration for all candidates; Phase C smoke was intentionally capped at two epochs.

explicitly_defined_setting.reason: The smoke trainer used no scheduler. D1 records that absence explicitly rather than adding a new hyperparameter.
